items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: if the whole bunch of the Ben Pollack band didn't come in, they had come all the way from Chicago to listen to us, listen to the Greystone band.

ctx.x: Did he play drums or did he front the band?

No, he played drums then. Fantastic drummer. "99 to the Bar," he used to tell us, but he was -- they had a feature that they used to do that knocked us out. They'd go along playing a tune you know, and play their choruses and this guy would play his chorus and that guy would play his chorus, and then they'd come to Benny's chorus and the rest of the band would drop out and it would be just drums and clarinet. My God, it was real -- it was great.
Of course, then Benny did it with Krupa later on in his own band.
